scope: Live PostgreSQL through Prisma in a disposable schema; private Blob sample upload/read/delete. Public database tables and migration history are not modified. Test identities are injected, not authenticated browser sessions.

checks.name: database: connect to the configured PostgreSQL server
database: apply both migrations in a disposable schema
database: add and read users, recipe, ingredients, and steps
database: modify and reread recipe, ingredient, and profile
database: enforce private/public reads with two test identities
database: roll back a recipe when its child write fails
database: delete a recipe and verify cascading child deletion
blob: upload a decoded sample PNG and persist its metadata
blob: read matching bytes and reject a second user's access
blob: delete the sample object and its metadata
database: remove the disposable test users
cleanup: no sample Blob objects remain
